ground_truth.title: H-15: Maverick oracle can be manipulated
ground_truth.description: MavEthOracle.getPriceInEth() reads the current token reserves of a Maverick boosted position, multiplies them by externally sourced token prices, and divides by boosted-position total supply. A flash-loan-funded swap can move the Maverick pool, alter getReserves(), and raise or lower the oracle LP-token value before reversing the swap.
ground_truth.impact: Decreasing the oracle price can lower the totalDebt of LMPVault and let a user receive more LMPVault shares. Increasing the oracle price can raise the totalDebt of LMPVault and let a user receive more withdrawn tokens. Manipulating the oracle price can also cause protocol miscalculations in the Stats contracts.
ground_truth.mitigation: Replace the transaction-local reserve-sum valuation with a Maverick-specific fair-LP calculation that derives fair reserves from trusted component prices and the position's applicable invariant.
